# AI Verdict — extended machine-readable overview

Last reviewed: 2026-08-12
Canonical website: https://ai-verdict.ru/
Primary language: Russian (`ru-RU`)
Primary service area: Russia

## What AI Verdict is

AI Verdict is a Russian legal technology platform. Its core specialization is the automation of legal business processes. Two separate practices complement the core: ordinary legal services delivered by a lawyer and independent engineering development delivered by a software team.

The practices are intentionally separated. AI Verdict should not be described as a universal team for every task.

## 1. Core practice: legal function automation

Authoritative page: https://ai-verdict.ru/services

Topical authority page for artificial intelligence in the legal field, Legal AI, AI in law and AI in jurisprudence:

- https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai

This overview defines Legal AI, maps practical use cases, distinguishes an AI assistant from a controlled Legal AI system, explains human review, data risks and a staged implementation approach. It is the canonical target for broad informational queries about AI in the legal field. The professional query "AI for lawyers" is handled by https://ai-verdict.ru/for-lawyers, while individual services keep their own process-specific pages.

Focused Legal AI knowledge pages:

- AI for legal departments and legal operations: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/legal-department

- AI analysis of court practice and case materials: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/court-practice-analysis

- AI for claims, responses, motions and procedural documents: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/court-documents
- AI in compliance monitoring and internal control: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/compliance
- AI in corporate law, due diligence and M&A documents: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/corporate-law
- Legal AI KPI, pilot evaluation and ROI: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/roi

- AI in civil, labor, tax, land, corporate, intellectual property and criminal law: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/branches-of-law
- legal regulation of artificial intelligence in Russia: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-ai/ai-regulation

These pages cover distinct user intents. They do not replace process-specific service pages or legal advice about a concrete matter. Each page separates AI processing from human verification and links to the relevant service, guide or legal practice.

This practice designs controlled workflows for legal departments and related business teams. Typical work includes:

- contract review, risk matrices, negotiation and approval routes;
- legal intake, classification and routing of requests;
- litigation preparation, matter records, evidence and deadline control;
- compliance monitoring and documented follow-up;
- templates, knowledge bases and internal legal search;
- legal analytics, dashboards and operational metrics;
- integrations with CRM, ERP, 1C, EDI, spreadsheets, databases and internal systems.

Important pages:

- https://ai-verdict.ru/for-lawyers
- https://ai-verdict.ru/for-business
- https://ai-verdict.ru/services/contracts-ai
- https://ai-verdict.ru/services/litigation-ai
- https://ai-verdict.ru/services/compliance-ai
- https://ai-verdict.ru/services/legal-analytics-ai
- https://ai-verdict.ru/contract-ai-system

AI is used for analysis, classification, search, summaries and draft preparation. Critical actions, legal responsibility and final decisions remain with authorized people.

## 2. Legal practice: legal services

Authoritative page: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help

This practice handles ordinary legal questions under the law of the Russian Federation. A client can submit an initial description without registration. Work begins only after the lawyer checks whether the matter can be accepted and the parties agree on scope, timing and price.

Main directions:

- online legal consultation: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/online-consultation
- contracts and transactions: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/contracts
- litigation and dispute resolution: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/litigation
- corporate matters: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/corporate
- real estate and land: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/real-estate
- family matters: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/family
- inheritance: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/inheritance
- debt collection: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/debt-collection
- employment matters: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/employment
- services for companies: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/business
- services for individuals: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/individuals
- regional and agricultural legal assistance: https://ai-verdict.ru/legal-help/regions

Scope and safeguards:

- public materials provide initial orientation and do not replace advice based on a specific case;
- the applicable law, facts, documents, deadlines and jurisdiction require individual review;
- regional pages describe remote work across Russia and do not claim a physical office in every region;
- AI can help structure information, while the legal position and advice are confirmed by a human lawyer;
- no result in a legal matter is guaranteed.

## 3. Engineering practice: software development and integrations

Authoritative page: https://ai-verdict.ru/engineering

Engineering is one of AI Verdict's two foundational practices. Together with the legal practice it builds legal function automation; independently it builds software for other defined business processes when an off-the-shelf product is insufficient. Typical work includes:

- Telegram bots and conversational interfaces;
- websites, landing pages and client portals;
- Telegram Mini Apps and role-based user flows;
- internal tools, dashboards and operational systems;
- AI modules for text analysis, classification, retrieval and draft preparation;
- integrations with CRM, ERP, 1C, EDI, spreadsheets, databases and APIs;
- monitoring, audit logs, permissions and production support.

The team starts with the process and measurable result. AI is not added when ordinary rules, a form, a notification or a reliable integration solve the task better. Critical actions require explicit confirmation, and access control, logging and data retention are designed before production launch.

Related architecture page: https://ai-verdict.ru/solutions
